setup: In Unity Analytics Event Manager, create and enable these custom events in development, assign the listed parameters, then copy the definitions to production. Reuse existing shared parameters with their existing types. Answer parameters must be optional.
identity: Unity supplies userID from the existing ResearchPlayerState.PlayerId through UnityServices.ExternalUserId. Do not add userID as a custom parameter. Join gameplay by userID and playthrough_id.
missing_answers: Omit unanswered item parameters. Zero is a neutral response, not missing data.
scoring: Keep Experience and Skill separate from PXI. Calculate a PXI construct mean only when all three construct items are answered. No scores or answer timing are recorded.
